self.achievementsHint: What you delivered this period and the impact it had. Concrete examples help your reviewer.
self.challengesHint: What got in the way, and what you learned from it.
self.developmentGoalsHint: What you want to learn or take on next, and the support you need.

manager.strengthsHint: What they did well, with examples. This explains the rating.
manager.developmentHint: Training, stretch assignments or support for the next period.
manager.promotionHint: Seen by HR and management only, never by the employee.
manager.potentialHint: How far could they grow beyond their role? Used in calibration only; never shown to them.

list.title: Reviews
list.subtitle: Your performance review and the reviews you write, in running cycles
list.emptyBody: When HR opens a review cycle, your self-assessment and the reviews you write appear here.
list.history: Past reviews are on your profile.

mine.waitingUnassigned: Waiting for HR to assign your reviewer
mine.meeting: {{ name }} will go through it with you in a feedback meeting
mine.shared: Your review is ready to read

queue.written: Written — you can still change it
queue.opensLater: Opens with the manager review phase
queue.missed: Not written before manager reviews closed — contact HR
queue.returned: Returned at sign-off — revise and send again

asked.givenEditable: Given — you can still edit it

review.selfLead: Reflect on the period: what you achieved, what was hard, and where you want to grow. Your reviewer reads it before writing your review.
review.selfPending: {{ name }} hasn't submitted a self-assessment yet.
review.selfClosed: Self-assessments are closed for this cycle.
review.selfVisibility: Your reviewer and HR can read it once you submit. You can change it until your review is written.
review.managerLead: Rate {{ name }}'s performance over the period and explain the rating.
review.managerHidden: Your reviewer's assessment is shared with you in your feedback meeting.
review.managerVisibility: The employee sees the review once it's shared in the feedback meeting — without the promotion recommendation or calibration.
review.noSelfBody: {{ name }} hasn't submitted one. You can still write the review.
review.meetingLead: Go through the review with {{ name }}, then record the meeting to share it with them.
review.meetingDialog: Recording the meeting shares the review with {{ name }}. Add notes on what you agreed — they see them too.
review.meetingNotesHint: Agreed next steps, goals or follow-ups.
review.ratingHidden: Your rating is shared with you in your feedback meeting.
review.calibratedFrom: Calibrated — the reviewer rated {{ from }} ({{ label }}).
review.calibrateDialog: Adjust {{ name }}'s rating so it's consistent across teams. The reviewer rated {{ rating }}.
review.calibrationNoteHint: Kept with HR and management; the employee doesn't see it.
review.whoSeesEmployee: Your reviewer and HR read your self-assessment. You see your review, rating and meeting notes once they're shared; promotion recommendations and calibration notes stay with HR and management.
review.whoSeesReviewer: The employee sees your review, the final rating and the meeting notes once you share them. Your own rating before calibration, the promotion recommendation and calibration notes stay with HR and management.
review.managerOnBehalf: {{ name }} hasn't written this review yet. HR can write it on their behalf if needed.
review.ackLead: Confirm you've read your review and add any comment. Acknowledging doesn't mean you agree with it.
review.ackCommentHint: Optional — anything you'd like on record about this review.
review.ackDispute: I disagree with this review and want HR to look at it
review.ackDisputeHint: Say what you disagree with in your comment. HR reviews it with your reviewer and gets back to you.
review.ackVisibility: Your reviewer and HR see your acknowledgement and comment. Once sent, it can't be changed.
review.disputePending: HR is looking into this dispute.
review.resolveDialog: Your answer is shared with {{name}} and their reviewer.
review.resolutionHint: What was reviewed and what was decided.
review.finalRatingHint: Change it only if the review is being corrected; the change is logged.

excluded.title: This review is out of the cycle
excluded.byHr: {{name}} took it out on {{date}}: {{reason}}. Nothing can be submitted on it unless HR puts it back.
excluded.leaver: {{reason}}. Nothing can be submitted on it.
excluded.employee: HR took your review out of this cycle, so there's nothing for you to do on it.

cycles.title: Review cycles
cycles.subtitle: Plan and run performance reviews across the company
cycles.proposalBody: Reviews {{ from }} – {{ to }}, opening {{ opens }} according to your review calendar.
cycles.emptyBody: Create a cycle to start a review round — the review calendar suggests the dates.
cycles.closedEmptyBody: Completed and archived cycles appear here.

cycle.reminded: Reminders sent to everyone with something left to do
cycle.draftBody: {{ count }} people are in scope today. Opening the self-assessment creates their reviews, assigns each manager as reviewer and notifies everyone.
cycle.noReviewsBody: Reviews are created when the self-assessment opens.
cycle.assignBody: Who writes {{ name }}'s review? They're notified right away.

openSelf.title: Open the self-assessment?
openSelf.body: Creates a review for each of the {{ count }} people in scope, with their manager as reviewer, and asks everyone to write their self-assessment. The cycle can't be edited afterwards.

startManager.title: Start manager reviews?
startManager.body: Reviewers are asked to write their reviews. Employees who haven't submitted can still do so until their review is written.

startCalibration.title: Start calibration?
startCalibration.body: Manager reviews close. HR can adjust ratings so they're consistent across teams before feedback.

startFeedback.title: Start feedback meetings?
startFeedback.body: Reviewers go through each review with the employee and record the meeting, which shares the review.

close.title: Close the cycle?
close.body: Every written review not shared in a meeting is shared with the employee now. Reviews never written stay unfinished.

archive.title: Archive the cycle?
archive.body: The cycle moves out of the way. Its reviews stay on each employee's profile.

startGoalSetting.title: Start goal setting?
startGoalSetting.body: Feedback meetings can still be recorded. Reviewers agree next period's goals with each employee before you close the cycle.

cycle.feedbackOff: This cycle doesn't collect feedback from colleagues.
cycle.signOffOn: Reviews waiting for sign-off, or returned, can't be calibrated or shared. Closing the cycle leaves them unshared.
cycle.signOffOff: Reviews don't need a second-level sign-off in this cycle.

membership.excludeTitle: Take this review out of the cycle?
membership.excludeBody: {{name}}'s review stops counting in the cycle's progress, ratings and reports, open feedback requests are closed and a pending sign-off is withdrawn. Nothing is deleted: you can put it back while the cycle runs.
membership.reasonHint: Kept with the review and shown to HR and the reviewer, never to the employee. Up to 500 characters.
membership.excluded: {{name}}'s review is out of the cycle.
membership.restored: {{name}}'s review is back in the cycle.
membership.addBody: For people who joined after the cycle opened. Only people the cycle covers and not in it yet are listed. Each gets a review with their manager as reviewer and is asked for a self-assessment.
membership.noneAddable: Nobody in the cycle's scope matches

moveBack.title: Go back to {{phase}}?
moveBack.body: Reopens the previous phase for a phase started too early. Work already submitted stays; the people who still have something to do are reminded. Not possible once a rating changed in calibration or a review was shared.

form.fromCalendar: Pre-filled from your review calendar. Adjust anything before creating.
form.name: Name
form.scopeHint: Working employees who joined before the period ends. Each manager reviews their direct reports.
form.draftOnly: A cycle can be changed until its self-assessment opens.

error.period: The period under review ends before it starts.
error.window: The cycle closes before it opens.
error.before: The {{ phase }} deadline is before {{ previous }}.
error.after: The {{ phase }} deadline is after the cycle closes.

form.collectFeedback: Reviewers can ask colleagues for feedback

feedbackVisibilityHint.MANAGER_ONLY: Feedback informs the reviewer; the employee never sees it.
feedbackVisibilityHint.SHARED_NAMED: Once the review is shared, the employee sees each colleague's feedback with their name.
feedbackVisibilityHint.SHARED_ANONYMOUS: Once the review is shared, the employee sees the feedback without names — only when at least 3 colleagues answered.

form.allowNominations: Employees can nominate colleagues (the reviewer approves)
form.feedbackHint: Colleagues are asked during the self-assessment and manager review phases, until the review is written.
form.requiresSignOff: Require a second-level sign-off of each review
form.signOffHint: Each written review goes to the reviewer's manager for sign-off before it can be calibrated or shared. They can sign it off or return it with comments. If nobody is above the reviewer, the sign-off is skipped.
form.peopleHint: Only current employees can be added.
form.scopeHintProbation: Employees in scope whose probation ends within the period, and who are not yet confirmed, are reviewed.
form.standardFormHint: Strengths, areas for improvement, development and an overall rating. Pick a template to add competencies and questions.
form.templateSummary: Adds {{ competencies }} competencies to rate and {{ questions }} questions to the standard form. It is copied when the cycle opens.

calendar.title: Review calendar
calendar.lead: When the company reviews and how long each step takes. New cycles are proposed from it; nothing starts on its own.
calendar.defaultsBody: One review a year on the calendar year. Save to make it your own.
calendar.cadenceHint: Twice a year adds a mid-year review.
calendar.yearStartHint: January for the calendar year, or the first month of your fiscal year.
calendar.opensHint: How long before the period ends the self-assessment opens.

phaseHint.manager: Reviewers rate and write their reviews.
phaseHint.feedback: Reviewers share the review in a one-to-one.

calendar.invalid: Use whole days: 0–90 before the period ends, 1–90 per step (calibration up to 60).
calendar.planLabel: A review cycle lasts {{ days }} days
calendar.planTotal: {{ days }} days from opening to the last feedback meeting — about {{ weeks }} weeks.
calendar.manualBody: Cycles are never created or opened automatically. Saving the calendar doesn't change existing cycles.

feedback.title: Feedback from colleagues
feedback.leadReviewer: Input from people who worked with {{name}}, to inform the review.
feedback.leadEmployee: Suggest colleagues who know your work; your reviewer approves each one.

employee.MANAGER_ONLY: Their feedback goes to your reviewer only.
employee.SHARED_NAMED: You'll see their feedback, with their names, once your review is shared.
employee.SHARED_ANONYMOUS: You'll see their feedback without names once your review is shared, if at least {{min}} colleagues answer.

reviewer.MANAGER_ONLY: Only you and HR see it; {{name}} doesn't.
reviewer.SHARED_NAMED: {{name}} sees it, with names, once the review is shared.
reviewer.SHARED_ANONYMOUS: {{name}} sees it without names once the review is shared, if at least {{min}} colleagues answer.

feedback.withheldBody: Fewer than {{min}} colleagues answered, so their feedback stays with your reviewer to protect who said what.
feedback.anonymous: Shared without names, in no particular order.
feedback.emptyReviewer: Nobody has been asked yet. Peers, direct reports or project leads can add perspective the reviewer doesn't have.
feedback.askDialog: They'll be asked for feedback on {{name}}'s work over the review period.
feedback.nominateDialog: Your reviewer approves the nomination before they're asked.
feedback.dueDateHint: Optional — a few days before manager reviews are due by default.
feedback.messageHint: Optional — what you'd like them to focus on.
feedback.turnDownHint: Optional — included in the notice to the employee who nominated them.

give.title: Feedback for {{name}}
give.lead: Share what {{name}} does well and where they could grow. Specific examples help most.
give.strengthsHint: What {{name}} does well — behaviours and results you've seen.
give.improvementsHint: Where they could grow, and how.
give.emptyTitle: Add strengths or areas to improve
give.emptyBody: Feedback needs at least one of the two.

visibility.MANAGER_ONLY: Your feedback goes to {{name}}'s reviewer and HR. {{name}} won't see it.
visibility.SHARED_NAMED: Your feedback goes to {{name}}'s reviewer and HR, and {{name}} sees it with your name once the review is shared.
visibility.SHARED_ANONYMOUS: Your feedback goes to {{name}}'s reviewer and HR. {{name}} sees it without your name once the review is shared, and only if enough colleagues answer to keep it anonymous.

give.declineDialog: Let {{name}}'s reviewer know why you can't give feedback.
give.closed: This request is closed: the review has been written.
give.tips: Describe what you saw and its impact, rather than personality. Keep to the review period, and be as candid as you would be in person.

signOff.title: Sign-off
signOff.waitingOn: Waiting for {{ name }} to sign off
signOff.approvedBy: Signed off by {{ name }} on {{ date }}
signOff.waived: Nobody above the reviewer to sign off, so the sign-off was skipped.
signOff.reviseHint: Revise the review and submit it again; it goes back for sign-off.
signOff.decideHint: Sign off {{ name }}'s review, or return it with what to change.
signOff.approveDialog: {{ name }}'s review of {{ employee }} can then be calibrated and shared.
signOff.returnDialog: {{ name }} revises the review of {{ employee }} and sends it again. {{ employee }} isn't told.
signOff.returned: The review was returned to {{ name }}

calibration.title: Calibration
calibration.lead: Compare the written reviews across teams before they're shared.
calibration.readOnlyPhase: Ratings and potential can be changed only during the calibration phase.
calibration.readOnlyRights: Changing ratings and potential needs the calibration permission.
calibration.blocked: {{ count }} review(s) are waiting for sign-off, or were returned, and can't be calibrated yet
calibration.emptyBody: Reviews appear here once their reviewers have rated them.
calibration.nineBoxLead: Performance (final rating) against potential. Select a box to list who is in it.
calibration.unplaced: {{ count }} review(s) have no potential yet and aren't on the grid.
calibration.distributionLead: Final ratings of {{ count }} written review(s).
calibration.guidanceHint: The guidance is a reference only: ratings are never forced to fit it.
calibration.dialog: {{ reviewer }} rated {{ name }} {{ rating }}. Changes are logged on the review.
calibration.noteRequired: Explain why the rating differs from the reviewer's.

hint.REGULAR: The periodic review of everyone in scope, such as the annual or mid-year review.
hint.PROBATION: Reviews employees whose probation ends within the period under review, so their reviewer can recommend the outcome.
hint.AD_HOC: Reviews the employees you name, for example on a role change or a project end.

probation.label: Probation outcome
probation.hint: Your recommendation to HR. It does not change the employee record and is never shown to the employee.
probation.required: Recommend an outcome for the probation.

framework.title: Competencies & templates
framework.lead: What reviews ask beyond the standard form: the competencies reviewers rate and the questions people answer. A cycle copies its template when it opens, so changes here never affect a cycle that has started.
framework.activeLabel: Available for new templates and cycles
framework.name: Name

categoryHint.VALUE: How people live the company’s values.
categoryHint.LEADERSHIP: Expected of people who lead others.
categoryHint.FUNCTIONAL: Specific to a role or function.

error.name: Give the template a name.
error.empty: Add at least one competency or question.

competency.emptyBody: Add your company values and the competencies reviewers should rate, with what each rating level looks like.
competency.anchorsHint: Describe the behaviour a reviewer should see for each rating. Reviewers see it while rating; leave a level blank if it needs no description.
competency.activeHint: A retired competency stays on the templates using it but can’t be added to others.

template.editHint: Cycles that have already opened keep the version they started with.
template.emptyBody: Without a template, reviews use the standard form. A template adds competencies to rate and questions for the employee and the reviewer.
template.competenciesHint: Each one is rated from 1 to 5 next to the overall rating, which stays the reviewer’s own judgement.
template.questionsHint: Asked in addition to the standard form. Employee questions are part of the self-assessment; the employee reads the reviewer’s answers once the review is shared.
template.question: Question
template.activeHint: A retired template stays on the cycles using it but can’t be picked for new ones.

competencies.title: Competencies
competencies.lead: Rate each competency from 1 to 5. Hover a rating to see what it looks like; the overall rating above stays your own judgement.
competencies.missing: Rate every competency and answer the required questions.

goals.title: Goals
goals.lead: Rate how far each goal due in the review period was achieved. This guides the overall rating but doesn't set it.
goals.readLead: The employee's goals due in the review period, with their latest progress.
goals.scoreHint: Not met 0, partially met 50, met 100, exceeded 120, weighted by each goal's weight (or equally). Guidance only.
goals.weightsOff: Goal weights add up to {{ total }}%, not 100%

retention.title: Record retention
retention.lead: How long performance review records are kept after a review period ends, and deleting them after.
retention.defaultsBody: Records are kept 6 years after the review period ends and nothing is deleted automatically. Save to confirm your company’s policy.
retention.keepHint: Counted from the end of each cycle’s review period. Check what your local law and company policy require.
retention.yearsInvalid: Enter a whole number of years from {{ min }} to {{ max }}.
retention.autoHint: Every night, cycles that are due are deleted. When off, nothing is deleted until you do it on this page.
retention.unsavedBody: The lists below follow the saved settings. Save to see what your changes would make due.
retention.dueHint: Archived cycles whose review period ended before {{ date }}, with nothing still open.
retention.noneDueOn: Cycles become due once archived and past the retention period, and are deleted the night after.
retention.noneDueOff: Cycles become due once archived and past the retention period. You delete them here.
retention.nextRunOn: These are deleted tonight, unless you delete them now.
retention.nextRunOff: Automatic deletion is off: these stay until you delete them.
retention.heldHint: Past the retention period, but kept until settled. Each one becomes due once nothing holds it back.
retention.deletedBody: The whole cycle: every review in it with the self-assessments, assessments, ratings, answers, feedback, calibration changes, sign-offs and meeting notes, plus the improvement plans and compensation proposals that followed.
retention.keptBody: Goals and their check-ins, position history, pay and bonuses already applied, notifications already sent, and the audit log — including a record of each deletion.
retention.policyBody: Data protection law (such as GDPR) expects personal data to be kept no longer than needed. Cycles still in dispute or follow-up are never deleted.
retention.purged: Deleted {{ cycles }} cycle(s) with {{ reviews }} review(s)
retention.purgeFailed: {{ count }} cycle(s) could not be deleted and were left as they were.

confirm.title: Delete review records permanently?
confirm.body: This deletes {{ cycles }} cycle(s) and {{ reviews }} review(s), with everything recorded under them. It cannot be undone.

goals.title: Goals
goals.lead: What you aim to achieve this period, agreed with your manager. Your review rates the goals due in its period.
goals.mineHint: Propose goals for your manager to agree, and record progress as you go.
goals.teamHint: Agree what your team proposes, set goals for them and follow progress.
goals.proposeHint: Your manager is asked to agree it. You can change or delete it until then.

field.title: Goal
field.successMeasureHint: Specific and measurable: what will be true when the goal is achieved.
field.weightHint: Optional. Share of the person's goals; together they should add up to 100%.

error.title: Name the goal.
error.employee: Choose who the goal is for.
error.dates: Set a start and due date.
error.dueBeforeStart: The goal can't be due before it starts.
error.weight: A weight is a whole number from 0 to 100.
error.progress: Progress is a whole number from 0 to 100.

goals.awaitingAgreement: Waiting for the manager to agree
goals.lockedHint: Rated in a review, so it can no longer be changed or cancelled.
goals.emptyBody: Propose your first goal. Once your manager agrees it, your next review rates how far it was achieved.
goals.emptyTeamTitle: No goals for your team yet
goals.emptyTeamBody: Set goals for the people reporting to you, or agree the ones they propose.
goals.checkInPlaceholder: What moved since last time, and what's blocking
goals.cancelBody: “{{ title }}” is no longer pursued and won't be rated. The employee is told why.
goals.deleteBody: “{{ title }}” was never agreed and is removed for good.
goals.proposed: “{{ title }}” was sent to your manager

improvementPlans.title: Improvement plans
improvementPlans.lead: Plans you run for people whose review was rated 2 or lower. Plans start from a shared review.
improvementPlans.drafted: Plan drafted. Review it, then share it with the employee.
improvementPlans.acknowledged: Thank you, your acknowledgement was recorded
improvementPlans.panelStart: This review was rated 2 or lower. If performance needs structured support, you can start an improvement plan. It stays a private draft until you share it.
improvementPlans.panelExists: An improvement plan was started from this review ({{ status }}).
improvementPlans.bannerBody: It runs until {{ date }}. Your manager will review progress with you along the way.
improvementPlans.bannerAcknowledge: It runs until {{ date }}. Please read it and confirm you received it.
improvementPlans.draftTitle: Draft: only you and HR see this
improvementPlans.draftBody: Check the objectives are specific and measurable, and the support is concrete. Sharing it notifies the employee and starts the plan.
improvementPlans.emptyBody: Plans are started from a shared review rated 2 or lower.
improvementPlans.objectivesLead: What is expected by the end of the plan, and how it is measured.
improvementPlans.whoSees: The employee once it's shared, their manager, whoever runs it, and HR. Not other reviewers or colleagues. The outcome is recorded only; it never changes the employee's status.

field.concernsHint: Specific, factual examples: what happened, when, and the expected standard.
field.objectivesHint: Specific and measurable, achievable within the plan's period.
field.successMeasureHint: e.g. 95% of tickets within SLA for 4 weeks
field.meetingCadenceHint: How often you will meet, e.g. weekly one-to-one.

error.duration: A plan runs for {{ minDays }} to {{ maxDays }} days.
error.objectives: Add at least one objective, each with a description.
error.objectiveDue: Objectives are due within the plan's period.

form.lead: A plan sets clear expectations and support over a fixed period. It is saved as a draft that only you and HR see.

activate.title: Share the plan?
activate.body: {{ name }} is notified and the plan starts. It can no longer be edited. Record check-ins, extend it once or close it with an outcome.

delete.title: Delete this draft?
delete.body: The draft was never shared and is removed for good.

acknowledge.title: Please confirm you received your plan
acknowledge.body: Read it carefully. Confirming records that you received it. It doesn't mean you agree, and you can add a comment.
acknowledge.dialogBody: This records that you received the plan, not that you agree with it.
acknowledge.commentHint: Anything you want on record, including where you disagree.

checkIn.title: Record a check-in
checkIn.placeholder: Progress on each objective, examples, and agreed next steps

extend.title: Extend the plan?
extend.body: A plan is extended once, by up to {{ days }} days. The employee is told the new end date and why.

close.title: Close the plan
close.body: The outcome is recorded and the employee is told. It doesn't change their status; any further step is a separate HR decision.
close.tooEarly: An unsuccessful outcome can be recorded once the plan's end date is reached.

compensationReview.title: Compensation review
compensationReview.lead: Turn a regular cycle's shared reviews into pay and promotion decisions, approved by a second person and applied once.
compensationReview.principleTitle: Ratings never change pay by themselves
compensationReview.principle: Each proposal is a decision someone makes, guided by the merit matrix. Pay changes only when an approved proposal is applied: the salary record is split on its date and payroll pays any bonus in that period. Your own proposal is handled by someone else and doesn't show here.
compensationReview.noCyclesBody: Pay decisions follow regular review cycles. Once a cycle shares its reviews, prepare them here.
compensationReview.readyTitle: {{count}} shared reviews are ready for a pay decision
compensationReview.readyBody: Draft one proposal for each, with the pay in effect on the date. No increase is filled in: set it per person, or use the merit matrix's midpoint.
compensationReview.waiting: {{count}} reviews aren't shared or rated yet.
compensationReview.disputed: {{count}} shared reviews have an open dispute and wait until it is resolved.
compensationReview.emptyBody: Proposals are drafted from the cycle's reviews once they are shared with a final rating.

totals.title: Totals
totals.lead: Base pay of those with a salary record, per currency and pay basis, before and after the proposals.
totals.none: Nobody here has a salary record on the proposals' dates.

compensationReview.payChanged: Pay or position changed since it was prepared: return it to draft and save it again
compensationReview.bonusRights: Applying it needs the permission to manage bonuses

edit.title: Pay decision for {{name}}
edit.newSalaryHint: Same basis and currency as today. Leave empty to keep it.
edit.noSalaryHint: No salary record on this date: set their pay on the Compensation tab first.
edit.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above zero, or leave it empty.
edit.bonusHint: Paid with the payroll of the effective date's period.

guidelines.title: Merit matrix
guidelines.lead: For each final rating, the base pay increase the company suggests, in percent. It is guidance: a proposal outside the range is flagged for the approver, never refused.
guidelines.invalid: Each range runs from 0 to 100%, and starts at or below where it ends.

returnDialog.title: Return to draft
returnDialog.body: {{name}}'s proposal goes back to draft, and its approval is cleared.

apply.title: Apply this pay change?
apply.body: This changes {{name}}'s pay records. It can't be undone from here.

delete.title: Delete this draft?
delete.body: {{name}}'s draft is deleted. Drafting the cycle again recreates it.

submitAll.title: Submit all drafts?
submitAll.body: {{count}} drafts go to approval. Your own, if any, stay with someone else.

approveAll.title: Approve all submitted?
approveAll.body: {{count}} proposals submitted by someone else get your approval.

guidance.title: Use the merit matrix's midpoint?
guidance.body: {{count}} drafts without a new salary get the midpoint of their rating's range. Salaries set by hand are kept.

confirm.bonus: Performance bonus of {{amount}}, paid with that period's payroll
confirm.nothing: Pay stays as is: the decision is only recorded.

performanceAnalytics.title: Performance analytics
performanceAnalytics.lead: Completion, ratings and outcomes across review cycles, by department. Counts only: no review text and no demographic breakdowns.
performanceAnalytics.emptyBody: Analytics appear once a cycle of this type has started.
performanceAnalytics.noneRated: No review in this cycle has a final rating yet.
performanceAnalytics.outcomesLead: Over rated reviews; disputes over shared ones.
performanceAnalytics.trendLead: The same measures across cycles, oldest first. Select a cycle to see it above.
performanceAnalytics.departmentsLead: {{cycle}}, by the department of the reviewed employee.
performanceAnalytics.definitions: Completion is over all reviews in the cycle; acknowledgements and disagreements over shared reviews. Ratings, changes, promotion recommendations and improvement plans are over rated reviews: written by the reviewer, with a final rating. A changed rating differs from the reviewer's own, after calibration or a dispute.
